NGA.note: Fingerprint and face capture is of suspects at a police station; no national ID system is described.
Document does not say who builds or runs the system or that Galaxy Backbone is a government body.

facts.fact: Daily Trust reports Gombe State has become the first beneficiary of a digital police station project, with Galaxy Backbone saying case files can now be managed digitally on a cloud-based system.
Daily Trust reports Gombe is the first state to receive the Galaxy Backbone and Nigeria Police Trust Fund digital police station, with no other station named.

systems.owner: Nigeria Police Trust Fund with Galaxy Backbone
